events.title: BlackBerry Torch released
events.summary: BlackBerry released the BlackBerry Torch — slider phone mixing touch and keyboard on BlackBerry OS 6.
events.about: BlackBerry dominated enterprise mobile before iPhone and Android. Slider phone mixing touch and keyboard on blackberry os 6. BES-connected apps and push email defined mobile workflows for years.

narrative.whyChosen: The BlackBerry Torch was a key BlackBerry hardware milestone.
narrative.whyImportant: BlackBerry hardware set expectations for mobile email and messaging security.
narrative.problemSolved: Business users needed secure mobile email before modern smartphone platforms.
